# axm subagents update

Update installed subagents to latest versions

## When to use

Update installed subagents to latest versions

## Usage

```bash
axm subagents update [flags] [<source>]
```

## Arguments

| Name     | Type   | Required | Description                                                           |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source` | string | No       | Filter to subagents from a specific source (owner/repo, path, or URL) |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Update subagents in project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--agent`       | string  | No       | Update only subagents installed for specific agent(s)                                      |
| `--subagent`    | string  | No       | Update only specific subagent(s) by name or glob pattern                                   |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Apply all updates without confirmation                                                     |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Update even if version constraints would prevent it                                        |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show available updates without applying them                                               |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Update all subagents to their latest versions**

```bash
axm subagents update
```

**Update a specific subagent**

```bash
axm subagents update --subagent researcher
```

**Update only subagents from a specific source**

```bash
axm subagents update owner/repo
```

**Preview available updates**

```bash
axm subagents update --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
